reason: The potato bay needs a lightproof skirt, and the packing foil and cover fabric look suitable for making one.
expectation: The foil and fabric will form a light-blocking skirt for the potato bed.

effect: The foil-backed cloth blocks light and should serve as the potato bay's skirt.
reaction: The lamp test makes its purpose clear.
reason: The prepared beds are the natural place to install the lightproof cloth before planting potatoes.
expectation: The cloth will form a lightproof skirt around the potato bay.

effect: The potato bay now shades the tubers while leaving shoots exposed to light, so it is ready for planting.
reaction: The distinction between dark roots and lit shoots is satisfying and clear.
reason: The seed potatoes belong in the newly prepared dark potato bay.
expectation: The potatoes will be planted in the shaded bay.

effect: The potatoes are planted and their goal is complete; soybeans and lettuce remain.
reaction: The deep, shaded bed makes the planting straightforward.
reason: The soybean seeds belong in their prepared growing bed.
expectation: The soybeans will be planted in their designated row.

effect: The soybean row is sown and its goal is complete; the early leaves remain.
reaction: The spaced pockets and aerated row make the planting easy to picture.
reason: The lettuce seeds belong in the remaining prepared tray.
expectation: The lettuce will be sown in the shallow tray, completing the early-leaves goal.

effect: The lettuce seeds currently have no available combination, so the tray may need another preparation first.
reaction: That was unexpected after the soybean planting.
reason: Inspecting the prepared beds may reveal what preparation is available before sowing lettuce.
expectation: The inspection will show any available partners for the beds.

effect: The inspection automatically installed a fabric wick, preparing the lettuce bed for sowing.
reaction: The wick explains the previously unavailable planting action.
reason: The lettuce seeds should now fit the prepared wicking bed.
expectation: The lettuce will be sown in the shallow wicking bed.

effect: The lettuce is sown in the damp wick, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: The shallow wicking tray gives the final planting a clear physical basis.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the potato bay was most worthwhile: the lamp test and installed skirt showed why tubers need darkness while shoots receive light.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed lettuce attempt was the least satisfying passage: the missing preparation was not apparent from the planting goal, though inspection resolved it.

surprise.text: I expected lettuce to plant directly like soybeans; instead, the tray needed a fabric wick to draw solution upward without another pump.

arbitrary.text: The need for a wick made physical sense once explained, but it was not clear beforehand why lettuce alone could not be planted immediately.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the crops develop and learn how the growing system supports them; the distinct potato and lettuce preparations made the construction meaningful.
